fieldOverrides.//: THE MICROCHIP LOOKUP. findPetByMicrochip() runs a collectionGroup('identity').where('code','==',…) query, and a collection-group scope on a SINGLE field is a field-level setting, not an index. It was declared in `indexes` above until 2026-08-12, when the first-ever deploy rejected it: 'this index is not necessary, configure using single field index controls'.
fieldOverrides.//2: A fieldOverride REPLACES the automatic single-field indexing for this field — it does not merge with it. The two COLLECTION entries below are Firestore's defaults and are re-listed deliberately; dropping them would silently disable ordinary per-pet queries on `code`. Only the COLLECTION_GROUP entry is new. arrayConfig is omitted on purpose: `code` is always a string (leading zeros are significant — see docs/rfid-microchips.md), never an array.
